verdict.rationale: LangGraph's multi-agent documentation describes patterns for building multi-agent systems in which specialized components coordinate on complex workflows. Its custom-workflow pattern lets other patterns be embedded as nodes in a single graph, and streaming exposes a separate subgraphs projection, which supports composing multiple agents inside one workflow. missing for 10: explicit documentation of handoff and subagent mechanics (the specific patterns are not enumerated in the evidence), and independent hands-on corroboration of multi-agent orchestration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can orchestrate multiple agents — handoffs, subagents, or crews — inside one workflow

citations.quote: Here are the main patterns for building multi-agent systems, each suited to different use cases
Multi-agent systems coordinate specialized components to tackle complex workflows.
Build bespoke execution flows with LangGraph, mixing deterministic logic and agentic behavior. Embed other patterns as nodes in your workflow.
Event streaming gives you separate iterators per projection (messages, values, subgraphs, output)
